summary: Nova Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release announcing record third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue reached $287.8 million, up 13% quarter-over-quarter and 28% year-over-year, with GAAP net income of $90.0 million ($2.64 per diluted share) and non-GAAP net income of $98.4 million ($2.86 per diluted share). Management guided fourth-quarter revenue to $305–315 million. The filing is a routine earnings current report with no transactional event, so it does not constitute a special situation; watch ordinary earnings-driven volatility.
